title: Optimize window partition keys
constraints: Preserve window function partitioning and ordering semantics
rationale: Window function execution first collected every row partition key into a Vec and then formatted each key with format!("{:?}", pk) before grouping. Value vectors are already hashable and can be used directly as partition keys.
steps: Group row indices directly while evaluating each partition key
Use HashMap<Vec<Value>, Vec<usize>> instead of debug string keys
Run existing window function integration regressions
expected_impact: Avoids an intermediate partition key vector and per-row debug string allocation during window function evaluation.
